about_the_game:
Create purrfect cat collars for your customers feline friends!

Design unique patches – drag and drop shapes from your inventory onto the design table, rotate and resize them, combine elements to invent eccentric patches, and then print them using a cute in‑game 3D printer.

Assemble bespoke collars – select belts, pendants and buckles from a wide range of materials and colours. Match them with your patches to create collars that are truly purrsonal.

Manage your workshop – organize and print your designs efficiently, keep track of orders and plan your day. Packing the finished collars and delivering them to your customers completes the loop.

Relax in a cozy atmosphere – soothing pixel‑art visuals, bright pastel colours and gentle animations create a comforting environment. Customer stories add an emotional layer that resonates with cat lovers and simulation fans alike.

Key features

  • Cozy pixel‑art simulation – soft, cartoonish visuals and bright pastel colours create a calm, homely atmosphere.

  • Drag‑and‑drop crafting – design unique patches with intuitive rotation and resizing tools.

  • Assemble the collar of your dreams – choose from 40 belts, 10 buckles and a variety of pendants to create endless combinations.

  • 3D‑printing mechanics – print your designs and see them come to life.

  • Emotional storytelling – meet customers with heart‑warming stories and design collars that reflect their tales.

  • Play at your own pace – no timers, no stress; enjoy a relaxing, non‑competitive gameplay loop ideal for casual gamers and crafting hobbyists.

  • Expandable content – collect 350+ designs in the base game

name: Purrfect Collars

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo or equivalent
  • Memory: 2048 MB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 compatible GPU (e.g., Intel HD Graphics 3000 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Onboard sound
  • Additional Notes: Runs on most low-end PCs
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i3 or equivalent
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with OpenGL 3.3+ support (e.g., NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Onboard sound
  • Additional Notes: Optimal performance on mid-range PCs

short_description: Purrfect Collars is a cozy single-player shopkeeping adventure. Design charming collars, connect with your customers, and grow your online store into a beloved haven. Each collar holds meaning, every cat a story!

English*, French*, Italian*, German*, Spanish - Spain*
